Hi,

I saw the Graphic Designer opening at deMasters Creative Studio and wanted to reach out directly, as I have been following your brand building and digital design work in Nagpur.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have produced over 100 digital and print creatives including marketing collateral, presentations, and social media assets while maintaining print-ready file management for bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.

For my branding kit work at AT Creation for startups, I developed end-to-end visual execution including logos, typography, and palette guidelines. You can view this visual identity work alongside my other projects on my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I would welcome a brief conversation to discuss how my brand identity and print production experience fits your studio needs.

Ananya
